name: FormInModal
title: Templates/Platform/Forms/FormInModal
summary: A short, blocking decision in a modal: an outlined `Item` row on the page names what the delete removes and holds the danger trigger, and the medium dialog it opens stacks a warning `Alert` over a labelled `FieldText` asking for the exact resource name, with Delete disabled until the typed name matches. The field clears every time the dialog opens, so its content stays in place while it closes. It is the form counterpart of the Delete dialog on the resource lists (Templates/Platform/Overlays/DeleteWithConfirmation), which renders the name as a copy chip with a bare input instead of a labelled field. Built from the platform shell, `Item`, `Dialog` with its trigger, portal, overlay, content, title and close parts, `PanelHeader`, `PanelContent`, `PanelFooter`, `Alert`, `FieldText` and `Button`.
